notes: Restores configured engine parameters rather than forcing a fresh discovery, which deviates from the spec and fails a hidden test; it also reformats many existing tests to add UnconnectedUDPSocket, and its recovering mock is somewhat contrived.

Restores the configured engine ID/boots/time on reconnect instead of clearing them, so no fresh discovery happens when engine_id is configured, contrary to the spec (and a hidden test fails); it also adds unexported fields to the wrapper struct.

The production change closely mirrors the reference, without clearing ContextEngineID, but the test edits hack TestSnmpInitGosmi (SMIPATH, skip, weakened displayhint assertions, require.NoError on the wrong err) and reformat unrelated configs.

The production fix is correct and well commented, but the test changes are noisy: struct realignment and UnconnectedUDPSocket edits, plus a TestSnmpInitGosmi hack (SMIPATH, symlinks, skips, weakened assertions) whose shadowed err lets Init failures pass silently.

A correct and thorough fix: it clears engine ID, boots, time, localized keys and ContextEngineID on reconnect, with an excellent mock-agent test of stale engine and rediscovery, though it carries unrelated test-environment edits.

Correct fix that also resets the derived keys and the context engine ID, with excellent tests including a fake agent that sends a stale-engine REPORT; it also touches translator_gosmi_test and existing connection tests for environment workarounds.

Functionally equivalent to the reference (no ContextEngineID reset, redundant Close wrapper) with reasonable wrapper and gather tests, but it changes the gosmi test data path to the parent directory and makes other unrelated test tweaks.

Matches the reference: the interface gains Close, Get and Walk reconnect first, a closed v3 session resets its engine state, and Gather closes on errors; the explicit Close is redundant, and existing tests were edited for the environment (all-127.0.0.1 caching test, gosmi path pointed at the parent dir).

Matches the reference: Close is added to the interface, Get/Walk reconnect first, engine params are reset on reconnect and the connection is closed on failure; it also clears the stale ContextEngineID, but adds a redundant Close wrapper and edits unrelated test addresses and gosmi paths.
Compact, correct fix with a context engine ID reset and focused tests; it carries unrelated environment edits to existing tests (all-same-address caching test, gosmi path).

A clean, well-documented fix with a resetEngineDiscovery helper (which also clears ContextEngineID) and close-error reporting; very strong tests, including a realistic SNMPv3 agent restart, offset by unrelated test-env tweaks.

Clean, well-documented fix (resetEngineDiscovery helper, close errors reported) with very thorough tests, including an end-to-end v3 agent restart and stop_on_error and per-agent cases; only the environment-driven edits to existing tests count against it.

Well written, with a realistic agent test that also checks contexts, but restoring configured engine params on reconnect means no fresh discovery when engine_id is set, contrary to the spec, and it fails a hidden test.

Well-structured and well-tested, including a realistic v3 restart agent, but restoring the configured engine parameters instead of clearing them misses the 'fresh discovery' requirement and fails a hidden test.

The core recovery works and ContextEngineID is cleared, but reconnect restores configured engine parameters instead of always rediscovering (failing a hidden test), and it rewrites production mib_loader.go to dodge a gosmi path issue that is unrelated to the task.
